source_text: Debbora prophetissa iudicabat Israel. Mulier iudex — quando viri torpent. Sedebat sub palma; filii Israel ascendebant ad iudicium.
pass_a_gloss: Deborah prophetess was-judging Israel. Woman judge — when men are-sluggish. She-was-sitting under palm; sons of-Israel were-going-up unto judgment.
pass_b_english: [[Deborah the prophetess was judging Israel >> Bible:Judges 4:4-5]]. A woman judges when men grow slack. She sat under the palm; Israel went up for judgment.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
